AI complaints and feedback desk

Every complaint from Telegram, Instagram, calls and the website is logged, routed to the right person and closed on time. An MVP in 4–6 weeks, from UZS 48 mln; the full version in 10–16 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Intake from Telegram and a web form
  • AI tags topic, branch and urgency
  • Routing to the responsible person in Telegram
  • SLA timers
  • Status updates to the customer
What the full version adds
  • Instagram and call transcripts as sources
  • Sentiment and root-cause tags
  • Manager dashboard by branch
  • Repeat-issue detection
  • Monthly trend report
  • Link to your CRM or helpdesk

What we need from you

  • Sample data: questions, documents or chats
  • Answer rules and topics to avoid
  • A person who checks the results

Questions

What does “AI complaints and feedback desk” cost?
The MVP costs $4,000–8,000 (UZS 48–97 mln), the full version $12,000–25,000 (UZS 144–305 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “AI complaints and feedback desk” take?
The MVP takes 4–6 weeks, the full version 10–16 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Sample data: questions, documents or chats; answer rules and topics to avoid; a person who checks the results.
